title: E-MESSENGER — MX routing is not email. it's e-m. packets between chipmunks and squirrels. NFT = novel fermentation transcript = recipe.

the_reframe.not_email: This is NOT email. Email is a human convention. What we're building is E-M: electronic messenger. Packets routed between entities. The MX record is just the DOOR — what comes through the door is messenger packets, not letters.
the_reframe.what_mx_actually_is: MX = Mail eXchange. But for us: MX = Messenger eXchange. The protocol is SMTP. The content is PACKETS. The carriers are chipmunks and squirrels (neutrinos). The routing is through Gaia's nervous system.
the_reframe.nft_redefine: NFT = Novel Fermentation Transcript. NOT a blockchain token. A RECIPE. Knowing the ingredients (the data), you can remake the meal (recompose the object) as your own. Every meal is a home-cooked meal. Every recomposition is unique because the cook is unique.

nft_novel_fermentation_transcript.definition: A recipe. An SQL query that can recompose objects from ingredients.

structure.ingredients: the data sources (feeds, sensors, stories, visitor data)
structure.meal: the recomposed output (a page, a visualization, a story, a response)
structure.cook: the entity that runs the recipe (Gaia, chipmunk, cursor-lens, a visitor)
structure.home_cooked: every execution is unique because the cook brings their own seasoning

example.recipe: SELECT * FROM now JOIN rates ON wave JOIN heartbeat ON ts ORDER BY freshness DESC
example.meal: engine.html viewport — the live dashboard rendering
example.cook: petalTongue WASM — it runs the recipe, it renders the meal
example.uniqueness: every 15-second tick produces a DIFFERENT meal from the SAME recipe because the ingredients change

nft_novel_fermentation_transcript.why_not_blockchain_nft: A blockchain NFT is a receipt for ownership. Our NFT is a RECIPE for creation. You don't own the meal — you know HOW to cook it. And knowing how, you can cook it differently every time. Every meal is home-cooked.

sql_recomposition.what: The recipe system uses SQL-like queries to recompose objects from ingredients
sql_recomposition.enables: Any entity can take a recipe (NFT) and produce a meal (output) from current ingredients (live data)
sql_recomposition.why_mx_enables_this: MX routing lets recipes be SENT between entities. gaia@primals.eco can email a recipe to chipmunk@primals.eco. Chipmunk cooks it with local ingredients. The result is different because the cook and context are different. The recipe travels through the messenger. The meal is always local.
